The four promoters held 44.92% at March 31, 2026 (60.64% a year earlier): Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw directly 29.90%, Glentec International 14.63% (she is its declared significant beneficial owner), her brother Ravi Mazumdar 0.33% and Dev Mazumdar 0.06%. notes: Fiscal year ended 31 March 2026 (data.js fy 'Mar 2026'); this edition skips FY25. Figures are from the Biocon Integrated Annual Report FY 2026 (financial statements approved May 7, 2026) and the Reg 31 shareholding pattern as at 31 March 2026. Consolidated statements are in Indian Rupees millions (÷ 1,000 = billions). OWNERSHIP: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw's 29.90% is her direct holding as stated in the consolidated notes (the shareholding pattern gives the same 484,581,970 shares and 29.90%). Her share count did not change; the percentage fell from 40.36% because the company issued 420,307,773 new shares in FY26 (two QIPs and share-swap allotments used to buy out Biocon Biologics minority holders, including Mylan Inc.). Glentec International holds a further 14.63%; the shareholding pattern names her as Glentec's significant beneficial owner, so Glentec is in `family` as her vehicle. The two are separate holdings and are not summed here. The promoter total is 44.92% (consolidated notes, shares held by promoters) and is not used as `family` because it already contains her own 29.90%. LARGEST HOLDERS are non-promoter holders named in the March 31, 2026 shareholding pattern: SBI Large & Midcap Fund 8.20% (the annual report's 5% table also lists it at 8.20%, printing 132,991,285 shares against the pattern's 132,991,385), Mylan Inc. 5.67% (allotted in the Biocon Biologics share swap; Mylan is part of Viatris, per the annual report's description of the transaction) and the LIC scheme as the filing prints it (insurance companies 6.16% in total). The Sep 30, 2026 shareholding pattern (1,629,694,135 shares) shows her at 29.73%; the fiscal-year-end figure is used here. DIVIDENDS: ₹668 million paid to owners of the company, from the consolidated statement of changes in equity; the cash-flow line (₹908 million) includes dividends to non-controlling interests (₹239 million in the SOCE). BUYBACKS: none; the only purchase line is ₹26 million of treasury shares bought by the ESOP trust, excluded. STOCK COMP: the consolidated cash-flow add-back (also in note 25 employee benefits), which includes Syngene and Biocon Biologics plans.
